title: SimpleVQA Fact-Centric Visual Question Answering Benchmark

nodes.label:
9x9 Knowledge & Task Taxonomy
Defines 9 Broad Domain Areas x 9 Cognitive Visual Tasks
Covers Science, Culture, Geography, Sports, Art, and Everyday Life

Multi-Source Visual Seed Harvest
Collects Real-World Photographs, Historical Records & Diagrams
Ensures Visual Diversity and High Information Density

Visual Factual Verifiability Screen
Checks Whether Visual Content Fully Supports Factual Inquiries
Eliminates Ambiguous Scenes with No Concrete Ground Truth

GPT-4o Question Refinement
Rephrases Initial Inquiries into Concise Short-Answer Questions
Enforces Unambiguous Semantic Focus and Exact Answer Formats

Automated Factual Screen
Employs LLM to Audit Question Simplicity & Non-Redundancy
Screens Out Multi-Step Convoluted Queries or Trivial Common Knowledge

Dual-Annotator Independent Review
Two Domain Specialists Independently Review and Answer Items
Resolves Disagreements and Filters Vague Formulations

Four-Frontier-Model Difficulty Filter
Probes Candidates with 4 Top VLMs to Eliminate Trivial Items
Retains Challenging Visual Questions Requiring Deep Perception

Atomic Question Decomposition
Decomposes Complex Inquiries into Atomic Fact Queries
Guarantees Each Item Targets Exactly One Verifiable Fact

Dual Independent URL Fact Verification
Verifies Factual Answer via At Least Two Authoritative Web Sources
Attaches Verified Source URLs to Golden Answer Metadata

Third-Party Senior Expert Adjudication
Third Senior Researcher Resolves Outstanding Annotation Disputes
Final Quality Sign-Off for Absolute Ground-Truth Accuracy

SimpleVQA Frozen Benchmark (2,025 Pairs)
Freezes 2,025 High-Quality Bilingual Visual Fact VQA Pairs
Balanced Across 9 Domains with Verified Web Citations

Image & Fact Query Prompt Formatting
Pairs High-Res Image with Short-Answer Factual Query
Demands Direct, Concise Output without Conversational Fluff

GPT-4o Automated Fact Evaluator
Advanced LLM-as-a-Judge Compares Predictions to Gold Answers
Evaluates Exact Synonymy, Entity Variations & Precision

Tri-State Outcome Classification (CO / NA / IN)
Classifies Predictions into Correct (CO), Not Attempted (NA) & Incorrect (IN)
Separates Confident Hallucinations from Rational Abstentions

CGA & F-Score Metric Computation
Computes Correct Given Attempted (CGA) and F-Score Harmonic Mean
Penalizes Both Reckless Hallucination and Excessive Abstention

SimpleVQA Domain Slices & CFQ Analysis
Reports Accuracy, CGA, F-Score across 9 Domains and CFQ (Certainty-Fact Quotient)
Provides In-Depth Factuality Diagnosis for Frontier VLMs
